## Complete RF Hardware Breakdown (/products)

## Product Category: Antenna Systems
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/antennas
Summary: High-reliability antenna systems engineered for harsh environments, base station communications, vehicle tracking, marine telemetry, and IoT wireless networks.

### VHF / UHF Base Station & Mobile Antennas
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/vhf-uhf-antennas
Description: Heavy-duty collinear omnidirectional and directional Yagi antennas covering VHF (136-174 MHz) and UHF (380-470 MHz) commercial and public safety bands.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Frequency Range: 136 - 174 MHz (VHF) / 380 - 470 MHz (UHF)
  - Nominal Gain: 3.5 dBi / 5.5 dBi / 8.5 dBi options
  - VSWR: < 1.5:1 across designated operating band
  - Impedance: 50 Ohms matched
  - Polarization: Vertical linear
  - Connector Type: N-Type Female / UHF (SO-239)
  - Power Handling: 150W continuous (up to 300W peak)
  - Material & Finish: Anodized high-grade aluminum, fiberglass radome
  - Mounting Hardware: Heavy-duty galvanized stainless steel mast clamps
  - Wind Survival: Up to 200 km/h with 0.5 inch radial ice

### GSM / LTE / 4G / 5G Cellular Antennas
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/gsm-lte-antennas
Description: Broadband cellular antennas in magnetic mount, rubber duck, and low-profile puck configurations supporting GSM 900/1800, 3G, 4G LTE, and sub-6 GHz 5G.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Frequency Range: 698 - 960 MHz & 1710 - 2700 MHz (Broadband)
  - Nominal Gain: 3.0 dBi (magnetic) / up to 12.0 dBi (directional panel)
  - VSWR: < 1.5:1 (typical)
  - Impedance: 50 Ohms
  - Polarization: Vertical linear
  - Connector Type: SMA-Male / N-Male / FME options
  - Cable Length: Standard 2m or 3m RG-58 / LMR-200 low-loss cable
  - Base Type: Heavy-duty rare earth magnetic base or screw-through panel
  - Operating Temp: -40°C to +85°C

### Wi-Fi / WLAN Dual-Band Antennas
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/wifi-wlan-antennas
Description: High-gain dual-band 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz Wi-Fi antennas in omnidirectional rubber duck, ceiling dome, directional panel, and cone configurations.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Frequency Range: 2400 - 2500 MHz & 5150 - 5850 MHz
  - Nominal Gain: 2.0 dBi, 5.0 dBi, 7.0 dBi, 10.0 dBi options
  - VSWR: < 1.5:1
  - Impedance: 50 Ohms
  - Polarization: Vertical / Dual polarization available
  - Connector Type: RP-SMA Male / N-Male / SMA
  - Housing Material: UV-resistant ABS radome (matte black / white)
  - Application: Industrial IoT routers, base stations, outdoor bridges

### GPS / GNSS Active & Passive Antennas
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/gps-gnss-antennas
Description: Precision active GPS L1, GLONASS, and Galileo reception antennas with integrated low-noise amplifier (LNA) for vehicle tracking and marine navigation.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Center Frequency: 1575.42 MHz ± 1.023 MHz (GPS L1) / 1602 MHz (GLONASS)
  - LNA Gain: 28 dB ± 2 dB integrated active amplification
  - Noise Figure: < 1.5 dB
  - Operating Voltage: 2.7V to 5.0V DC phantom power via coax
  - VSWR: < 1.5:1
  - Connector Type: SMA Male / MCX / MMCX / Fakra
  - Ingress Protection: IP67 waterproof sealed aerodynamic puck
  - Mounting: Internal magnet or permanent screw-bolt mount

### Log-Periodic & Wideband Antennas
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/lpa-wideband-antennas
Description: Broadband directional log-periodic dipole arrays (LPA) covering wide spectrums for EMC testing, surveillance, and multi-band telemetry.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Frequency Range: 400 MHz to 6.0 GHz (Continuous broadband)
  - Nominal Gain: 8.0 dBi to 11.0 dBi directional gain
  - Front-to-Back Ratio: > 20 dB
  - VSWR: < 1.8:1 typical across entire band
  - Impedance: 50 Ohms
  - Connector Type: N-Type Female precision coax
  - Power Rating: 100W continuous CW
  - Construction: Laser-cut corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy boom

### UHF RFID Reader Antennas
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rfid-antennas
Description: Circularly polarized UHF RFID reader panel antennas for automated warehouse inventory, asset tracking portals, and logistics gates.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Frequency Range: 865 - 868 MHz (India/EU) / 902 - 928 MHz (US FCC)
  - Nominal Gain: 6.0 to 9.0 dBic (Circular polarization)
  - Axial Ratio: < 2.0 dB at boresight
  - Beamwidth (3dB): 68° Horizontal x 68° Vertical
  - Connector Type: TNC Female / SMA Female
  - Radome Material: Heavy-duty impact-resistant polycarbonate
  - Mounting: Standard VESA 75/100 and pole clamp brackets

## Product Category: RF Passive Components
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-passive-components
Summary: Precision machined RF passive hardware delivering ultra-low insertion loss, high power handling, and sharp out-of-band rejection.

### High-Q RF Cavity Duplexers
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-cavity-duplexers
Description: Precision CNC-machined cavity duplexers for VHF and UHF repeater base stations providing superior TX/RX frequency isolation.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Frequency Range: 136 - 174 MHz (VHF) / 380 - 470 MHz (UHF)
  - Channel Spacing: Min 4.5 MHz (VHF) / Min 5.0 MHz (UHF)
  - Isolation (TX/RX): > 80 dB minimum (up to 90 dB)
  - Insertion Loss: < 0.8 dB typical
  - Power Handling: 50W / 100W / 250W continuous options
  - Impedance: 50 Ohms with VSWR < 1.3:1
  - Connectors: N-Type Female with silver-plated contact pins
  - Tuning Method: Precision brass adjustment rods with locknuts

### Directional Couplers & Power Taps
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-directional-couplers
Description: Low PIM broad-band directional couplers for signal monitoring, transmitter power reflection measurement, and distributed antenna systems.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Frequency Range: 698 - 2700 MHz (Broadband)
  - Coupling Values: 6 dB, 10 dB, 15 dB, 20 dB, 30 dB
  - Directivity: > 20 dB
  - Insertion Loss: < 0.25 dB (for 20dB coupler)
  - Power Rating: 200W average, 1 kW peak
  - Connector Type: N-Type Female / 4.3-10 DIN options
  - Enclosure: Tri-metal plated brass / aluminum alloy

### Power Splitters & Combiners
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-power-splitters
Description: 2-Way, 3-Way, and 4-Way reactive power dividers for multi-antenna transmitter feeds and cellular coverage distribution.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Frequency Range: 698 - 3800 MHz (Covers 4G & 5G bands)
  - Split Configuration: 2-Way / 3-Way / 4-Way symmetrical
  - Insertion Loss: < 0.15 dB above theoretical split
  - Port Impedance: 50 Ohms nominal
  - Power Rating: 300W continuous average power
  - VSWR: < 1.25:1 all ports
  - Connectors: N-Type Female / 4.3-10 Female

### RF Coaxial Fixed Attenuators
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-coaxial-attenuators
Description: Precision continuous power RF attenuators engineered for test equipment protection, power leveling, and impedance matching.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Frequency Range: DC to 3.0 GHz / DC to 6.0 GHz
  - Attenuation Values: 3 dB, 6 dB, 10 dB, 20 dB, 30 dB, 40 dB
  - Accuracy: ± 0.3 dB to ± 0.6 dB
  - Power Handling: 5W, 10W, 25W, 50W, 100W CW options
  - Impedance: 50 Ohms with VSWR < 1.2:1
  - Heat Sink: Black anodized aluminum radial cooling fins
  - Connectors: SMA Male to Female / N-Type Male to Female

### Cavity Band Pass Filters
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-bandpass-filters
Description: Narrowband and wideband cavity filters providing steep skirt selectivity and deep rejection of out-of-band interference.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Center Frequencies: VHF, UHF, 868 MHz, 915 MHz, 2.4 GHz tuned
  - Rejection Level: > 60 dB at ± 10% from center frequency
  - Passband Loss: < 1.0 dB across designated 3dB bandwidth
  - Input Power: Up to 100W CW
  - VSWR: < 1.3:1 in passband
  - Connectors: N-Type Female precision coax

## Product Category: RF Cables & Connectivity
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-cables-connectivity
Summary: Mil-spec and industrial grade low-loss RF coaxial cable assemblies, phase-stable jumper cables, and adapters tested 100% on Vector Network Analyzers.

### Low-Loss RF Coaxial Cable Assemblies
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-coaxial-cable-assemblies
Description: Custom length coaxial cables (LMR-400, LMR-200, RG-58, RG-174, RG-213) terminated with precision gold and silver plated connectors.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Cable Types: LMR-400 (ultra-low loss), LMR-200, RG-58 C/U, RG-174, RG-213
  - Attenuation (LMR-400): < 0.22 dB/meter at 2.4 GHz; < 0.13 dB/meter at 900 MHz
  - Connector Standards: SMA (Male/Female/RP), N-Type (Male/Female), BNC, TNC, MCX
  - Testing: 100% VNA return loss and insertion loss certified
  - Jacket Material: UV-resistant weatherproof non-halogenated PE jacket
  - Customization: Fabricated to exact millimetre lengths with adhesive heat-shrink

### RF Lightning & Surge Protectors
URL: https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-lightning-surge-arrestors
Description: Gas discharge tube coaxial lightning protectors shielding base stations and transceivers against electrical surges and direct lightning strikes.
Technical Specifications (Anand Technologies RF Standard):
  - Frequency Range: DC to 3.0 GHz / DC to 6.0 GHz
  - Surge Discharge Current: 20 kA (8/20 µs waveform)
  - Sparkover Voltage: 230V ± 20% DC
  - Insertion Loss: < 0.15 dB
  - VSWR: < 1.2:1
  - Connectors: N-Female to N-Female / N-Male to N-Female bulkheads
  - Weatherproofing: IP67 waterproof silicone O-ring sealing
